# Contributing

Thanks for taking the time to contribute!

## Getting started

1. Fork the repository and create your branch from `main`.
2. Make your changes, keeping commits focused and well-described.
3. Make sure the project builds and any existing tests/lints pass.
4. Open a pull request describing what changed and why.

## Reporting issues

- Search existing issues first to avoid duplicates.
- Use the provided issue templates (bug report / feature request) where possible.
- Include enough detail (steps to reproduce, environment, logs) for the issue to be actionable.

## Pull requests

- Keep PRs focused on a single change — smaller PRs are easier to review.
- Reference any related issue in the PR description.
- Be responsive to review feedback; it's meant to help land the change, not gatekeep it.

## Code of conduct

By participating, you're expected to uphold this project's [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
